description: Follows Billy Pilgrim’s fractured time, connecting war, destruction, narrative form, fatalism, and the difficulty of representing traumatic experience. Covers Why does a war book refuse to behave like a war book?; The frame: an author who does not know how to begin; A narrative whose time does not heal; What remains after the retelling.
